contract: GET /public/share/:slug. Public share slug creates/reuses a cookie-bound playbackSession with requested resume time and consumed share/audioTrack fields; expired/missing shares deny and expire once.
exceptions: force is not applicable: no share management or public consumer route has a force, hard or refresh/override mode.

invariants.contract: GET /public/share/:slug is unauthenticated. An unknown slug answers 404 with no Set-Cookie. Otherwise it answers 200 with the share's client fields (id, mediaItemId, mediaItemType, slug, expiresAt null or ISO, createdAt, updatedAt, isDownloadable) and a playbackSession (playMethod 0, mediaPlayer 'web-share', clientName 'Abs Web Share', deviceInfo.deviceId equal to the share_session_id cookie) plus the item's tracks, chapters, duration and coverPath. Without a cookie it creates a session and a 30-day httpOnly share_session_id cookie from ?t (clamped at 0 and reset to 0 beyond the total duration); a known cookie for this share reuses the session and an in-duration ?t overrides currentTime; a cookie bound to another share closes that session and creates this share's session on the same cookie. A share past expiresAt is removed and answers 404; a podcastEpisode share answers 404 because only book library items are resolved. Timed shares are reopened and scheduled on server start, while a row whose expiresAt passed while the server was down is deleted on load and its slug answers 404.
exceptions: Share playback sessions live only in ShareManager: a slug read or progress write creates no playbackSessions row; the share device is persisted in devices with clientName 'Abs Web Share'.
A malformed share_session_id is cleared and then reused verbatim as the new session id, as upstream does.
